message.title: Aker ASA: Invitation to Presentation of Third Quarter Results 2026
message.body:
Aker ASA will publish its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on
Wednesday November 4, 2026, at 07:00 CET. An online webcast presentation of
the results will be available the same day at 09:00 CET.

Webcast details:

Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
Time: 09:00am CET
Format: Webcast
Language: English
Link: www.akerasa.com/webcast

There will be a live Q&A session following the presentation. Questions may
also be submitted in advance to fredrik.berge@akerasa.com

The presentation and material will be made available at www.akerasa.com
(http://www.akerasa.com/) and www.newsweb.no (http://www.newsweb.no/)

-ENDS-

Investor contact:
Fredrik Berge, Head of Investor Relations
+47 45 03 20 90
fredrik.berge@akerasa.com

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section
5-12 the Norwegian Securities Trading Act
